summary: Frontend-only regression for redesigned Add/Edit Storage modal. All 8 scenarios from the review request passed: modal opens with Connection Type Select as first field (default S3 selected + s3-bucket-input visible), switching type via Select updates fields and default port (SFTP=2222, Samba=445, back to S3 ok), eye toggles work for s3-secret-key, sftp-password, samba-password (type flips password->text), created REDESIGN_sftp via 127.0.0.1:2222 with sftptest/testpass123 -> 'Connection successful' toast + card appeared, Edit prefetched config, prefilled all fields, eye toggle revealed testpass123, new X close button (close-storage-dialog) dismissed dialog without saving (card count unchanged), and delete cleanup succeeded. No console/page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Storages.jsx (399 lines) is nearing the 700-line threshold and mixes list, cards, and modal into one file. Consider extracting StorageModal and StorageCard when this file grows further.

openEdit() shows the modal before the /storages/{id}/config fetch resolves; briefly the password field is empty (rendered before secrets arrive). Minor UX polish: show a loading state or await before setOpen(true).
changeType keeps stale S3/samba/sftp values in form.config when the user switches types. Not a bug (payload() picks only relevant keys), but the config object accumulates unused fields.
seed_data_creation: Created REDESIGN_sftp storage during test and deleted it in cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Radix Select opens as a portal and its options are clickable with force=True. Tests used data-testid storage-type-select then storage-type-{s3|samba|sftp}. All modal fields have expected data-testids as listed in review. Iteration 9 SFTP live server still reachable at 127.0.0.1:2222.
